newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Africa Israel 6-mth net 40 mln shekels - sources.
newsitem.headline: Africa Israel 6-mth net 40 mln shekels - sources.

text.p: Africa Israel Investment Co Ltd net profit in the first half of this year will be 40 million shekels against 57 million shekels in the same period last year, well-placed industry sources said.
In the whole of 1995 net profit was 110 million shekels.
Net profit from regular operations (including insurance) was 65 million shekels in the first half of the year against 57 million shekels in the same period last year.
Officials at Africa Israel said they were not allowed to comment on results before the report is released tomorrow.
In the first quarter of this year the company reported a net profit of 35.38 million shekels, against a net profit of 24.72 million in the same period last year.
The company is a subsidiary of Bank Leumi.
